title: Decision Events KPI Weekly Aggregation Authority

responsibilities.unknown_policy: scripts/send-decision-kpi-to-slack.js reads decision events only through the existing companion access guard (GET /api/companion/decision-events) and never reads the month-file ledger directly, so it never gains authority beyond what the companion API already grants. It never fabricates a delegation or rework rate when the denominator is zero; it must report 計測不能 instead. It is intended to run co-located with the Brainbase server (launchd/cron), not as a GitHub Actions workflow, because the companion API is server-to-server only and hosted-runner reachability is not guaranteed.
